The '''Mengal system listening post''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] listening post in the [[Mengal system/Legends|Mengal system]]. It intercepted coded [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] messages that led to the capture of an Imperial cargo [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] passing through the region.<ref name="TOR" />
